'''Baker Company''' was a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of ten [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtroopers]] that were [[Mission to Goratak III|deployed]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Goratak III]] in an effort to recover an [[I2-CG droid/Legends|I2-CG]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]]
